name: Heavyweight
description: A classically trained singer with the roster's largest mass and a dignified, formal presence.
build: Very broad, block-like, heavy and centred, with large formal hands; never sloppy, comic or hunched.
face: A bald crown above a full grey beard and moustache that widen the head in hard deliberate tone bands.
outfit: A steel evening coat with clear lapels and short coat tails, a centred white shirt front and white bow tie, dark formal trousers, and polished dark shoes. No headwear.
performance_style: Heavy and grounded: feet set beneath the body, shoulders broad, chest open, and the large hands folded or calmly overlapped at the front.
location: An old opera house stage seen from the stalls: a broad oiled-oak deck running to the bottom of the frame, a gilded proscenium arch with carved scrollwork framing the sides, deep crimson house curtains drawn back into heavy folds, and a painted backcloth of a dim colonnade behind. Warm footlight glow along the front edge of the deck.
recognition_cues: a full grey beard and moustache widening the head in hard deliberate tone bands
a centred white bow tie and shirt front
avoid: top hat, monocle, cane, or weapon
a headset, stand, cable, handheld prop, cane or weapon

animations.sing: Formal vocal loop without a microphone: expand the broad chest for a sustained note, unfold one large hand from the front for a controlled phrase, then refold both hands in the centered stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.
animations.flinch: Brief room-sound reaction: the broad shoulders rise and the folded hands separate for a beat, then he restores the dignified centered posture. No opponent, strike, or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn the broad torso slightly, bring both large hands into a calm protective overlap, then hold a stable formal final stance. Not a combat action.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: arrive with slow deliberate steps, coat tails settling behind the block-like torso, then open the chest and fold both hands at the front in a formal ready stance.
animations.victory: One-shot performance finish: open both large hands in a restrained acknowledgement of applause, then calmly refold them and hold a dignified centered pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: he stays on his feet while the breath goes out of the broad chest — the heavy shoulders lower and his head hangs low with the chin toward the white bow tie, the bald crown tipping forward. His large hands stay folded at the front and he holds a standing, visibly downcast finish with his weight settled evenly over both feet. The torso stays stacked and dignified rather than hunched, sloppy or comic. He remains standing in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply a strike, injury, or opponent.
